title: Japanese Curry

ingredientGroups.title: Curry
items: 1 Tbsp ginger, grated or minced fine
1-2 lb chicken, cut into bite sized pieces

steps: Add 1-2 Tbsp of oil to a large heavy pot and saute onions until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, and shredded apple, and saute another minute until it is no longer raw.
Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stock to a smooth, even texture.
Add the honey, ketchup, soy sauce, salt, and roux then stir until incorporated.  Use the immersion blended if the roux is difficult to mix in.
Add the chicken and potatoes, then cover and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Add the carrots and simmer for another 5 minutes.

components.title: Quick Homemade Roux (optional)

items: 2 Tbsp curry powder (S&B Oriental Curry Powder)

steps: Melt butter over low heat and stir in flour to combine.  Continue to whisk for 10 minutes until the mixture is a light brown color, like a milky peanut butter.  Add the remaining ingredients and whisk together for another 30 seconds.
